owners.label: Tides of Succession
owners.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, when Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison or Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison, her ATK is increased by 50% for 8s. Switching to another Resonator ends this effect.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, after Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare, Hsin gains 25% Electro DMG Bonus, stacking up to 2 times. Each Resonator can trigger this effect only once. In addition, if Rover: Electro is in the same team, when Rover: Electro casts Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury, both Hsin and Rover: Electro gain 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s.
This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

owners.label: Gleaning Simple Joys
owners.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, the maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stacks of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare and Hsin is not in the Heart Manifest state, Hsin gains 1 stack of Thunderglow after Resonators in the team other than Hsin inflict Electro Flare, stacking up to 10 times.
While Hsin is in the Heart Manifest state, when targets within a certain range around the active Resonator have 0 stacks of Electro Flare, inflict 1 stack of Electro Flare on the targets. If Thunderglow on Hsin reaches the stack limit, Hsin also inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the targets:
- When Hsin inflicts Fleeting Thunder on the target, she also inflicts Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- When Fleeting Thunder is active, if the maximum stacks of Electro Flare on the target are increased, Hsin will inflict Electro Flare on the target to the stack limit again, up to 16 stacks of Electro Flare.
- Fleeting Thunder will be removed when the target leaves the designated range around Hsin.
Exiting the Heart Manifest state or switching Resonance Mode removes the effects mentioned above.

owners.label: Herself a Thousand Lanterns
owners.description:
Attack the target, dealing Electro DMG equal to 100% of Hsin's ATK.
Hsin gains Nightglow after entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven. When Hsin casts Outro Skill, Nightglow is consumed to trigger various effects depending on the Resonance Mode She is in:
- While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonators in the team other than Hsin gain Shared Light when they gain Unison. After Hsin casts Outro Skill, Resonators with Shared Light gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Electro DMG dealt by Resonators in the team other than Hsin is Amplified by 20% for 20s.
The above effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

owners.label: A Boat to Cross the Rising Tide
owners.description:
Casting Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin 2 stacks of Radiance Ward, stacking up to 2 times. Switching to Answering Form clears all stacks. When Hsin takes DMG from an enemy target's attack, 1 stack of Radiance Ward can be consumed to make Her immune to interruption and reduce DMG taken by 60% for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 1s.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison are increased by 15%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases the DMG Multipliers of Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison and Intro Skill - Illumining Form: Manifold Unison by 10%, up to a total 4 stacks.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When Hsin enters combat, if Heart of Thunder is below 50 stacks, it is increased to 50 stacks, triggered once every 4s.
The DMG Multiplier of Electro Flare DMG dealt when Forte Circuit - Resonance Skill: Illumining Form hits a target and consumes 5 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=A} of Heart of Thunder is increased to 210%. The DMG Multiplier of Electro Flare DMG dealt when Forte Circuit - Resonance Skill: Heartward by Moon consumes all remaining Heart of Thunder at once is increased to 42%.

owners.label: To Wake Is to Wonder What I Am
owners.description:
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Wanderer and Heavy Attack - Answering Form: Realm Protector are increased by 60%.
The DMG Multipliers of Heavy Attack - Illumining Form: Beholding All Horizons and Heravy Attack - Illumining Form: Stilling All Horizons are increased by 60%.

When Hsin enters combat, the Cooldowns for Hsin to gain Resolution of Wishes and Law of Heaven are reset. If Hsin is in Answering Form, 100 additional points of Answering Heart are also restored. This effect can be triggered once every 4s.

owners.label: A Dream of Return Among the Hills
owners.description:
The DMG Multiplier of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 70%.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The Crit. DMG of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven is increased by 20%, and each stack of Unison Boon additionally increases its Crit. DMG by 15%, stacking up to 4 times.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
When the last stage of Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven hits a target inflicted with Electro Flare, it triggers 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG, with its DMG Multiplier equal to 1500% times the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the current Electro Flare stacks on the target.

owners.label: A River of Lanterns, a River of Wishes
owners.description: When Resonators in the team inflict Electro Flare or Electro Rage to a target, or when Resonators in the team gain Unison or trigger Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 20% All-Attribute DMG Bonus for 30s.

owners.label: Forms Turn as the Heart Wills
owners.description:
While in Illumining Form, DMG taken by Hsin is reduced by 20%.
When Hsin takes a fatal blow, She will not be knocked out, but instead restores 100% of Max HP and becomes immune to DMG and interruption for 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 10 minute.

owners.label: The Moon Owes Its Light to the Living
owners.description:
Targets take 40% more Resonance Skill DMG from Hsin.

Resonance Skill DMG dealt by Hsin ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

While in Resonance Mode - Unison:
The maximum stacks of the Unison Boon effect on Resonators in the team are increased by 1. When a Resonator in the team triggers Unison Response, all Resonators in the team gain 1 stack of Unison Boon for 30s. This effect does not stack.

While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare:
While in combat, Electro Flare DMG taken by targets within a certain range around Hsin can be Critical, with Crit. Rate fixed at 80% and Crit. DMG fixed at 230%.

owners.label: Resonance Mode
owners.description:
While in Resonance Mode - Unison, Hsin gains the following effects:
- Hsin can trigger Unison Response.
- After Hsin casts Intro Skill - Answering Form or Intro Skill - Answering Form: Manifold Unison, the next cast of Resonance Liberation - Formshift grants Hsin Unison for 5s.

owners.label: Unison Boon
owners.description: Each stack of Unison Boon increases the total DMG dealt by Resonators with the Unison Response ability in the team by 3%, stacking up to 2 times.

owners.label: Heart of Thunder
owners.description: Some time after casting Resonance Skill - Heartward by Moon, Hsin consumes all remaining stacks of Heart of Thunder at once to trigger 1 instance of Electro Flare DMG. Its DMG Multiplier equals 35% x (the number of Heart of Thunder stacks consumed this time) x (the Electro Flare DMG Multiplier corresponding to the target's current Electro Flare stacks).

owners.label: Tides of Succession: Thunderous Fury
owners.description: While in Resonance Mode - Electro Flare with Rover: Electro in the team, Rover: Electro casting Intro Skill - Thunderous Fury grants both Hsin and Rover: Electro 20% Electro DMG Bonus for 30s. This effect resets when a Resonator is added to the team or when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.

owners.label: Outro Skill: Herself a Thousand Lanterns
owners.description:
After Hsin gains Nightglow by entering combat or casting Resonance Liberation - Pillars Across Heaven, casting Outro Skill consumes it to apply one effect based on Hsin's current Resonance Mode:
- In Resonance Mode - Unison, Resonators with Shared Light gain 20% All DMG Amplification for 30s.
- In Resonance Mode - Electro Flare, Electro DMG dealt by Resonators in the team other than Hsin is Amplified by 20% for 20s.
These effects end early when Hsin switches Resonance Mode.
